adapter_contract.fixture: Provide each declared state fixture; load the initial_state fixture before dispatch.
adapter_contract.keyboard: Dispatch the key with modifiers, then assert every field in the case's assert mapping.
adapter_contract.accessibility: Capture the actual platform accessibility tree and compare declared semantics.
adapter_contract.screenshots: Render each state/theme/scale case and compare its named baseline.

keyboard_cases.precondition: editor is focused and port navigation is inactive
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Focus the next node in deterministic reading order.

keyboard_cases.precondition: editor is focused and port navigation is inactive
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Focus the previous node in deterministic reading order.
Select the focused node.
Enter that node's port navigation path.
Focus the next port in the current node.
Return focus to the node.
Pan the graph viewport to the left.
Zoom in at the viewport center.
Zoom out at the viewport center.
Fit all finite graph bounds into the viewport.
Set actual-size scale and center the graph bounds.
Add the focused node to selection.
Toggle the focused node in selection.

keyboard_cases.precondition: one or more nodes are selected
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Propose moving selected nodes one graph unit to the right.
Begin keyboard box selection around the focused node.
Move the active selection corner one graph unit to the right.
Commit the full-containment selection.

keyboard_cases.precondition: a movement or box preview is active
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Cancel the preview without emitting a graph edit.
Choose the focused output as connection source.
Focus the next compatible input candidate in reading order.
Focus the previous compatible input candidate.

keyboard_cases.precondition: a valid input candidate is focused
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Request the connection and clear the preview.
Request removal of the focused connection.
Toggle the minimap visibility.
Focus the next existing connection.
Request removal of that connection.
Center the viewport on that node.
Cancel the source preview without a graph edit.
Toggle minimap visibility.
Focus the next compatible input candidate.
